name: kling-creator
description: Python reverse-engineered API client for Kling AI (klingai.com / klingai.kuaishou.com) — text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, video extend. Supports Kling 1.0–2.1 and Kolors image models.
author: yihong0618

capabilities.image_generation: Text-to-image with Kolors models (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.1), 1–9 images, ratios 1:1 to 21:9
capabilities.image_to_image: Image-to-image generation from local file or URL
capabilities.video_generation: Text-to-video with Kling models (1.0, 1.5, 1.6, 2.1), standard or high-quality
capabilities.image_to_video: Animate a still image into a video clip
capabilities.video_extend: Extend a generated video from 5s to 10s

security_review.notes: Pure Python HTTP client using requests library. No eval(), no subprocess shell=True, no remote code execution. Cookie-based auth against klingai.com APIs. Standard image/video download to local files.
